component.name: HardlyWatching
component.summary: Download queue and viewer for Instagram and TikTok

description.p: Queues profiles, downloads their posts, stories, highlights and reels into a local archive, and shows that archive as a gallery and a shorts feed. One copy of the logic serves both the desktop window and the browser.
Downloads are rate-limited on purpose and pause when the site says to come back later. Everything stays on the machine: the app has no server of its own and no account anywhere.
Zoom now grows the viewer's frame instead of cropping the picture, and a missing TikTok picture is retried on the page as well as fetched in the background. 0.3.4 carried the count bar fix alone.
The TikTok count bar is two tidy rows with "all" always on the card.
The TikTok count bar wraps instead of clipping its "all" button off the card.
Find byte-identical copies in the archive and move them to Trash.
